title: Matata and Chebet break course records in Yangzhou

story.W: Miriam Chebet pulled away in the later stages and won in 1:06:27, taking 38 seconds off the course record. Ftaw Zeray was second, 35 seconds back.
story.M: Alex Nzioka Matata defended his title in 59:11, 20 seconds under his own course record from last year, and won by 19 seconds from Jemal Mekonen. Kenyans swept the elite titles for the third year running.

performances.name: Alex Nzioka MATATA
performances.note: Won in 59:11, a course record, a personal best and a Chinese all-comers' record. Now owns the three fastest half marathons run in China; had won Meishan in 59:51 two weeks earlier.

performances.name: Jemal MEKONEN
performances.note: Second in 59:30. Called Jemal Yimer Mekonen in the report.

performances.name: Geofry Toroitich KIPCHUMBA
performances.note: Third in 59:57. Called Geoffrey Toroitich Kipchumba in the report.

performances.name: Miriam CHEBET
performances.note: Won in 1:06:27, a course record, 20 seconds off her best from Istanbul last year; came in on good form after a 30:08 10km in Valencia in January.

performances.name: Ftaw ZERAY
performances.note: Second in 1:07:02. Called Ftaw Zeray Bezabh in the report.
